title: Course Verdict
description: Return of a course checker: its judgement of one fix group's diff against the group's finding(s)

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

finding_id.description: The finding that decided the verdict

verdict.description: How the fix went: better means it moved toward the finding, wrong-direction means it moved away from the finding, broke-something means it broke working behaviour

mistake.description: The kind of mistake the fix made; none only with better

what_went_wrong.description: What went wrong, empty for better
